title: fix(platform-objects): sys_member transfer_ownership says the target becomes an owner and the caller keeps their role
body:
Fixes #24273

Clause-②: no (provisional: copy only; if the measurement forces another shape, the dev reports before building it; owes the seat's review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT` before the queue)

## What changed

`sys_member.transfer_ownership` sends better-auth's `POST /organization/update-member-role` with `role: 'owner'`. better-auth 1.7.3's `updateMemberRole` writes the target's role and nothing else, so the caller stays an owner. The action used to promise "You will be demoted to admin". Shape **B** (honest copy) from the claim: the action now promises what the door does.

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts`, `transfer_ownership`:
  - label FROM "Transfer Ownership" TO "Make Owner";
  - confirmText TO "Make the selected member an owner of this organization? They get every owner privilege, including deleting the organization. You stay an owner too; to step down, use Change Role on your own membership.";
  - successMessage FROM "Ownership transferred" TO "Member is now an owner" (the old one claimed a transfer as well);
  - the comment now states the vendor behavior, the step-down, and the vendor's last-owner guard. It points at the dogfood test that measures them.
  - Unchanged: `name`, `target`, `recordIdParam`, `bodyExtra`, `visible`, `requiresFeature`, `requiresMembershipReach`, `variant`, `icon`.
- Bundles: `en.objects.generated.ts` was regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. The `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` values are hand-written translations, and merge mode keeps them, so each one would have kept the false promise. I translated them again to the same honest copy. Each confirm names that locale's own Change Role label (更改角色 / ロールを変更 / Cambiar rol).
- Pins:
  - `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/transfer-ownership-action-copy.test.ts` checks four things on the declared copy and every locale bundle: no demotion or transfer is promised, the confirm names the locale's `update_member_role` label, `en` equals the declared copy, and the request and identity are unchanged.
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/member-transfer-ownership-step-down.dogfood.test.ts` is the booted measurement below.
- Changeset `.changeset/24273-transfer-ownership-honest.md` (`@objectstack/platform-objects`: patch).

## Measurement (booted stack, before the copy changed)

The dogfood file boots the showcase, makes two organizations with two signed-up non-platform-admin principals, and activates the organization under test. It reads both `sys_member` rows after each write.

1. Owner runs the action's request on a plain member: **200**, rows read `{ owner: 'owner', target: 'owner' }`, so the organization has two owners. This reproduces the card.
2. The served `update_member_role` predicate, evaluated with `celEngine` against the caller's own row and the caller's served session (`org_owner` in positions), returns **true**: Change Role is offered on one's own row.
3. The previous owner sends `update-member-role` on their OWN row with `role: 'admin'`: **200**, rows read `{ owner: 'admin', target: 'owner' }`. The step-down works through a declared action.
4. The new sole owner tries the same: **400** `YOU_CANNOT_LEAVE_THE_ORGANIZATION_WITHOUT_AN_OWNER`, and the rows are unchanged. This is the vendor's last-owner guard (`crud-members.mjs`, `updateMemberRole`).
5. The second organization's rows are unchanged.

So B holds: the previous owner can step down through a declared action, and nothing calls for shape A.

Pre-fix run (`2ba4d44d`): 4 behavior cases pass and the served-copy case is red (`expected 'Transfer Ownership | Transfer ownersh…' not to match /demot/i`). Post-fix: 5/5 pass.

## Verification (final head `f31e05504`, after merging `origin/main` `31e7d0ba2`)

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`: exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 77 files, 1184 tests passed
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/member-transfer-ownership-step-down.dogfood.test.ts test/org-admin-affordance-reach.dogfood.test.ts`: 2 files, 19 tests passed
- Reverse leg: with `sys-member.object.ts` and the four bundles restored to `2a1e48a1c1` (tree only, restored with `git checkout HEAD`, then `git diff HEAD` empty), `transfer-ownership-action-copy.test.ts` fails 6 of 8. It passes 8 of 8 on the fix.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 69 families on `ccac32c44`. 68 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because unrelated packages had no `dist/`, so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
- After the merge, these were re-run on `f31e05504`, all exit 0: `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`.

## Downstream (cloud)

cloud#2912's booted test (cloud PR #3003) expects the caller's `sys_member.role` to be `admin` right after `transfer_ownership`. Under this PR that expectation is `owner`. The `admin` reading belongs only after the caller's own `update-member-role` on their own row with `role: 'admin'`. If that test asserts the copy, it should also expect the new label "Make Owner".

## Acceptance notes

- The measurement runs on the `single` boot shape. `@objectstack/organizations` is not a dependency of `@objectstack/dogfood`, so the framework's multi-org gates skip here (`enterprise-organizations.ts`). The two organizations are rows written in system context, the shape `org-admin-affordance-reach.dogfood.test.ts` uses. The door under test is the vendor's own endpoint either way.
- `packages/spec` test fixtures (`action.test.ts`, `action-requires-membership-reach.test.ts`) use the label "Transfer Ownership" on standalone fixture actions. They are not the served copy and are outside this lane, so they are left as they are.
- `packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md` holds an old entry that repeats the vendor claim ("auto-demotes the previous owner to admin"). It is release-owned and not edited in a code PR.
